title: How NVIDIA engineers and researchers build with Codex
summary: Teams use Codex with GPT-5.5 to ship production systems and turn research ideas into runnable experiments.
body: Teams use Codex with GPT-5.5 to ship production systems and turn research ideas into runnable experiments.
summaryZh: 本文介绍了NVIDIA工程师如何利用Codex与GPT-5.5模型构建生产系统，将研究构想转化为可运行的实验。通过这种集成，团队能够显著提升开发效率，实现从研究到生产的快速迭代。原始信息显示：Teams use Codex with GPT-5.5 to ship production systems and turn research ideas into runnable experiments.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“How NVIDIA engineers and researchers build with Codex”。其重要性主要体现在：展示了顶级科技公司如何将前沿模型集成至生产环境以加速研发流程。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
